summary.intent: Execute all 22 plans (14 original + 8 gap-closure) of GSD phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) via wave-based orchestrated subagent execution, driving the app from ~6/208 to fully-passing web-e2e coverage, then verify and diagnose live bugs the user found by hand.
summary.outcome: 14 original plans landed across 5 waves; verification found gaps (SC#3/SC#4/SC#5 unmet); a gap-closure round planned 8 more plans (68.1-15..22) which executed across another 5 waves, fixing durable IPNS registration, shared-browser kind-cache, D-05 stale-record UX, SHARE-WRITE-KEY wiring, and a user-reported text-editor decryption bug; e2e failures dropped from 17→13→8, but the exit-gate agent died on an account session limit before finishing, requiring manual recovery of uncommitted fixture fixes and a second verification pass.

repo: GSD execute-phase orchestrator uses git worktrees per parallel subagent within a wave, merges them back, then runs post-merge build+test+drift gates before advancing waves
Decimal phases (68.1) are gap-closure/sub-phases of a parent integer phase (68) and require close_parent_artifacts handling (parent UAT) at completion

createFolder for owned subfolders must enroll new IPNS records with encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch for TEE republish — omitting this leaves zero rows in ipns_records/ipns_republish_schedule, so records die at IPNS TTL (48h) or on any dev routing-store restart

mock-ipns-routing dev container stores records in-memory only (in-memory Map) — restarting it silently wipes all unregistered IPNS records, which was mistaken for a 'propagation timeout' bug (GAP-2) until traced

mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 (IPv6) while the app binds IPv4-only, causing a permanently 'unhealthy' container status unrelated to the app actually working; fix is `127.0.0.1` in docker-compose.yml healthcheck
API dev server runs on :3000, not :3001 — :3001 is the mock-ipns-routing delegated-routing mock used by DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL

migration `1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover` dropped the `shares` table's plaintext `item_name` column entirely; share.service.ts's toSentShare/toReceivedShare hardcode itemName:'' so the REQ-4 name-backfill feature is permanently dead code (documented as GAP-6, cannot be revived without violating zero-knowledge design)

The live `/shares` and `/shares/invites` REST API grants an entire subtree via one ECIES wrap of the root readKey — there's no server-side per-child-key field, making the plan's original collectChildKeys/ChildKeyDto design architecturally obsolete (superseded, see prior memory)

sdk-core's issueReadGrant/claimInvite produce base64 payloads but live share/invite DTOs are hex-only — web code must call wrapKey/unwrapKey directly with hex encoding instead of routing through sdk-core's grant primitives

Write-permission share/invite creation requires the parent folder's writeKey, which only exists in CipherBoxClient's private FolderState — not threaded to any web UI layer as of 68.1-01, requiring a dedicated cross-cutting gap-closure plan (SHARE-WRITE-KEY)

client.downloadFromIpns / resolveFileMetadata bug: passing the parent folderKey instead of the file's own readKey silently type-checks (both Uint8Array) but causes AEAD decrypt failure — surfaced only as 'Decryption failed' in the text editor; fix must recover the file readKey via unsealChildReadKey using the SealedChildRef before calling sdk-core
Files uploaded before the fileReadKey seal fix have a permanently mis-sealed parent ref in dev data — this is data damage requiring re-upload, not a code regression

Serial Playwright specs (describe.serial) abort at first failure, so failure counts overstate coverage: most 'failing' groups die during setup, leaving deep specs (e.g. full-workflow 6.5.x text-editor decrypt) never executed even when the suite reports green elsewhere
gap-analysis.plan-post is a non-blocking advisory gate distinct from the blocking decision-coverage gate

code.finding: Informational decision tags must be placed inside the bold ID group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not appended after the closing bold — placement outside the group is silently ignored by the parser
mock-ipns-routing healthcheck used `wget localhost` (resolves IPv6 ::1) instead of `127.0.0.1`, causing a permanent false-unhealthy status; fixed and committed as ba574574c

downloadFromIpns/resolveFileMetadata call site fed the parent folderKey instead of the file's own readKey into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata; fixed in commit de2807ec8 to recover the correct key via unsealChildReadKey

fetchShareKeys/fetchPendingRotations/updateSharePermission were live throwing stubs; fail-closed to []/no-op in 68.1-20 (commit 503fe480f) rather than crashing, and toReceivedShare now populates writeDescriptorRef for write-key derivation

workflow: When a background subagent's completion notification never fires (transcript eviction / lost wake), resuming via SendMessage with the agent's task-id restores full context and lets it continue — cheaper than restarting from scratch

Arming an independent Bash watchdog (poll until a results file like .last-run.json lands) is a useful backstop against agent wake-loss for long-running background suites, used successfully twice in this session

When an orchestrator's own tail/grep masks a subprocess's real exit code, always re-run capturing the actual exit status before trusting a 'pass' summary — caught a masked SDK test gate failure this way

Verifying a headed/live spec run alongside the user builds trust and catches real bugs (nested-folder creation, text-editor decryption) that automated e2e coverage structurally couldn't reach due to serial-abort shadowing

An agent's self-reported `expected_base` in worktree_metadata can be wrong (reported its own docs commit instead of the true fork point) — the orchestrator should independently verify the fork base via git before recording/merging

friction: Wave 1 agent for plan 68.1-01 stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 min) requiring a spot-check fallback and background resume

Exit-gate agent (68.1-13) lost its completion signal after the first full 208-spec e2e run finished — session sat idle for a long stretch until the user complained, requiring manual liveness/log inspection and a SendMessage resume
Exit-gate agent (68.1-22) repeated the same lost-wake pattern on the second gap-closure e2e run, requiring another manual resume via watchdog + SendMessage
A prohibited `git stash push`/pop mistake by the 68.1-16 subagent left a stray stash entry that had to be identified and dropped during wave cleanup
git index.lock transient contention blocked a Wave 3 tracking commit, requiring a lock-state check and retry
gsd-tools task list (TaskCreate items) didn't survive a session hand-off mid-phase, forcing the orchestrator to proceed without it for the remaining linear sequence

Exit-gate agent (68.1-22) hit the account's session usage limit (resets 3am Europe/Berlin) mid-triage, dying with uncommitted fixture fixes that had to be manually recovered, debugged (3 iterations: crypto mock factory, non-UUID node id, mock-once fixture), and committed by the orchestrator directly
Permission denial when reading docker-compose/healthcheck config lines that likely touched a .env-adjacent file, forcing a split into smaller reads
open_items: GAP-1 (AEAD decrypt failure for CTR video preview + batch-download) and GAP-2 (cold-reload multi-level IPNS DFS timeout) were surfaced by the first exit gate — GAP-2 partially addressed via retry-budget fix in second gap round
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still rides the now-empty share_keys fan-out and always returns an empty picker list — documented as a follow-up gap in 68.1-20's SUMMARY

GAP-6: REQ-4 itemName backfill feature is permanently dead code after the item_name column was dropped in ApiSchemaCutover migration — needs a deliberate feature-retirement or redesign decision, left undecided
conflict-detection e2e spec still failing after the 'adopt published state after publish' fix (3cdf20e28) — root cause not fully covered
sharing-workflow and shared-folder-move e2e failures need further triage (re-wrapping verification, SharedMoveDialog empty-picker gap)
rotation-durability SC-4 e2e failure not yet triaged
recovery IPFS-direct v2 blob e2e failure documented as an expected residual, not fixed
Final phase 68.1 re-verification (gsd-verifier round 2) was in progress at transcript end — outcome not yet known
Dev vault has data damage: files uploaded before the fileReadKey seal fix have permanently mis-sealed parent refs and will keep failing to decrypt regardless of the code fix
